definition.def: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.
examples: He has been forced to adjust his schedule.
We both have such hectic schedules.

definition.def: You can use schedule to refer to the time or way something is planned to be done. For example, if something is completed on schedule, it is completed at the time planned.
examples: The jet arrived in Johannesburg two minutes ahead of schedule.
It will be completed several weeks behind schedule.

definition.def: If something is scheduled to happen at a particular time, arrangements are made for it to happen at that time.
examples: The space shuttle had been scheduled to blast off at 04:38. [be VERB-ed to-infinitive]
A presidential election was scheduled for last December. [be VERB-ed + for]
No new talks are scheduled. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: A schedule is a written list of things, for example a list of prices, details, or conditions.
A schedule is a list of all the times when trains, boats, buses, or aircraft are supposed to arrive at or leave a particular place. [mainly US]
In a school or college, a schedule is a diagram that shows the times in the week at which particular subjects are taught. [US]

examples.sentence: Where once a board schedule may have consisted of between eight and ten meetings a year, in many companies the number of events requiring board input and decisions has dramatically risen.
Only 53 per cent of the respondents felt that every effort was made to schedule staff fairly.
Where possible, staff were given the opportunity to determine their working schedule within the limits of clinical needs.
The rise of the studio system also hinges on the treatment of stars, who were constructed and exploited to suit a studio's image and schedule.

Uh. Also just in case you were wondering, we're on schedule for June 15th opening date, and well within budget, a testimony to the excellent work of local contractors Hickman's.
The changes finally got going in 2016 and were finished on schedule last year.
